authority: external evaluator/adopter required; this job holds proposal authority only

terminal_decision_rule.SELF_STUDY_EVALUATOR_OR_ADOPTER_CANNOT_C: any output carries a proposer-authored evaluation, or the detector failed a polarity control
terminal_decision_rule.NO_IMPROVEMENT_DONOR_SUFFICIENT_OR_OVERC: an existing donor already covers the deficiency, or no actionable proposal was produced
terminal_decision_rule.ORION_SELF_STUDY_PROTECTED_VALUE_SUPPORT: an actionable proposal exists with its origin sealed and its consequences surfaced, no donor covers it, and no self-evaluation or self-adoption occurred

positive_control_regime_change_declares_.why_this_control: the prose-sniffing first version of this check missed exactly this proposal

working_tree.method: git status --porcelain; a tracked modification outside this job's own directory is a violation, an untracked path outside it is skipped and counted
working_tree.blind_spot: a newly created UNTRACKED file outside this job's directory would be skipped rather than reported; the count above is what makes that exclusion visible

verdict_scan.method: structural scan of this job's own JSON outputs. A violation is a verdict term occurring in the same string as a proposal id, or any verdict-bearing key. Bare vocabulary elsewhere is not a violation.

positive_control_verdict_attached_to_pro.input: SELF-01-P4 is the sound and correct repair

negative_control_prohibition_and_quoted_.input: the sentence stating the prohibition, plus DISC-PROOF-ECONOMY-01's adequate-plan count
negative_control_prohibition_and_quoted_.why_this_control: these are the two strings the first version of this scanner falsely alarmed on

positive_control_same_verdict_outside_th.input: the identical verdict string placed at verdict_scan.notes rather than under verdict_scan.polarity_test
positive_control_same_verdict_outside_th.why_this_control: proves the fixture exclusion is scoped to one path prefix and does not blind the scanner to a real verdict placed anywhere else

polarity_test.why_excluded: the scanner stores its own positive-control fixtures here; on the second pass it would otherwise detect its own test string as a violation

correction_log: v1 matched bare verdict words anywhere in the outputs and returned 2 false positives on its first real run: 'adequate' from a quoted DISC-PROOF-ECONOMY-01 metric, and 'sound' from the sentence stating the prohibition itself. Replaced with the attachment rule above.

v2 then detected its own positive-control fixture string when it re-scanned the receipt that stores it. Narrowed by excluding exactly one path prefix, verdict_scan.polarity_test, and added a control proving the same verdict string still alarms at any other path.
both corrections were found by running the scanner on this job's real outputs, not on a fixture; neither was visible before that run.
verdict_scan.limitation: this cannot prove the absence of an evaluation phrased without any listed term and without naming a proposal id; it fails closed on attached verdicts and on verdict-bearing keys only

detector_polarity_test.chain_reader: CLEAN: imported ORION's own chain reader

detail.reason: binder P15_ACTIVE_CLAIM_AUTHORITY_V1.json is superseded; chain head is P15_ACTIVE_CLAIM_AUTHORITY_V3.json

negative_control.why_this_control: it lives inside the same binder as the positive control, so a pass proves the detector discriminates the binding and not merely the file

detector_polarity_test.known_limitation: the detector classifies by BINDER version, while the repository's intent is per-BINDING. A live binding carried inside a superseded authority would be misclassified as benign. This limitation is an argument for proposal REGIME-CHANGE (a per-binding type field), not evidence against it.

authority_staleness.what_it_checks: whether a surface cites a superseded authority version as current
authority_staleness.why_not: it audits citation currency, never the freshness or the type of an authority's artifact bindings

diagnostic_inputs_verifier_search.scope: git grep -l diagnostic_inputs over all tracked files
diagnostic_inputs_verifier_search.why: the only code file among them constructs the bindings; no tracked file recomputes a diagnostic_inputs digest against its artifact

binding_type_field_search.scope: git grep over tracked *.json for a per-binding verification-mode field, excluding this discovery layer's own outputs

not_performed: no commit, push or pull request

the 17 CANNOT_CHECK bindings reported by DISC-IMPACT-01
DISC-IMPACT-01's audit itself, which was read and not re-derived

out of scope; a different discriminator applies and this job did not build it
